title: The Value of Names: Civil Society, Information, and Governing Multinationals,
title_zh: 名称的价值：公民社会、信息与跨国公司的治理
authors: David H Kreitmeir, Nathan Lane, Paul A Raschky
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: Abstract Can markets discipline socially costly misbehavior abroad? We explore the market penalty associated with major human rights violations—specifically, the assassination of mining activists, a context where formal legal recourse is rare and events often do not involve counterparties. We show that firms featured in media coverage of these incidents experience significant, negative abnormal stock returns. Whereas reactions to related forms of corporate misconduct may be transitory or muted, we find that the market responses are both substantial and persistent, with a median 10-day loss exceeding USD 100 million. Since formal legal sanction is exceedingly rare, we consider the role of market penalties. We highlight three mechanisms that are consistent with reputational costs: (1) Media attention magnifies the market response. (2) Information-sensitive institutional investors systematically divest following assassination events. (3) Events reduce future trade, leading to a 19% decline in new contracts with counterparties. Despite these costs, events persist. We find that assassinations increase with dependence on mining royalties, suggesting that local rents sustain conflict despite market pressure. Thus, reputational sanctions may be significant—even in weakly institutionalized settings—yet may not fully deter misbehavior when local and global incentives diverge.
abstract_zh: 市场能否对海外高成本不当行为形成约束？本文聚焦重大人权侵犯事件——具体而言，即采矿活动人士遇刺事件（此类情境下正式法律救济极为罕见，且事件通常不涉及交易对手方），探究市场惩罚机制。研究表明，媒体报道中涉及此类事件的企业会遭受显著且负面的异常股票收益。相较于企业不当行为相关反应可能具有短暂性或弱化特征，我们发现市场反应既显著又持久，其中位10日损失超过1亿美元。鉴于正式法律制裁极为罕见，我们重点考察市场惩罚的作用机制。我们提出与声誉成本相一致的三种传导路径：（1）媒体关注放大了市场反应；（2）信息敏感型机构投资者在刺杀事件后系统性减持；（3）事件导致未来贸易减少，新合同签订量下降19%。尽管存在这些成本，事件仍持续发生。研究发现，刺杀事件与矿业特许权使用费依赖度呈正相关，表明即便面临市场压力，地方租金仍会维持冲突。因此，声誉制裁在制度薄弱环境中可能具有显著效力，但当地方与全球激励存在分歧时，未必能完全遏制不当行为。

title: DP21707 Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
title_zh: 文献综述与证据汇总：应用微观经济学工具包
authors: Maximilian Kasy, Peter Ganong, Avik Garg, Maximilian Kasy; Peter Ganong; Avik Garg
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect---after correcting for selectivity---is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.
abstract_zh: 考虑一位分析师，其目标是预测某一效应的大小。她已确定一组关于类似效应的先前已发表研究。我们提供了一套工具包，用于：(i) 总结先前文献，(ii) 预测新情境下的效应，以及 (iii) 纠正先前文献中选择性偏差带来的偏误。我们通过来自劳动经济学、公共经济学、行为经济学、环境经济学和发展经济学的实证案例来展示这些方法。即便仅有三项先前研究可用，部分工具仍具适用性。我们展示了如何通过重新加权先前估计值，利用协变量透明地预测新情境下的效应。在我们的实证案例中，经选择性偏差校正后的平均效应，仅为简单均值的12%至21%。最后，我们为从事元分析的研究者提供了一份操作指南。

title: The Aggregate Costs of Uninsurable Business Risk
title_zh: 不可保险商业风险的总体成本
authors: Corina Boar, Denis Gorea, Virgiliu Midrigan
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We use firm-level data to document that private businesses experience large fluctuations in their profit shares. These are due to large, fat-tailed, and transitory changes in output that are not fully accompanied by changes in their inputs. We interpret this evidence using a model of entrepreneurial dynamics. Because firms can limit their exposure to risk by operating at a smaller scale, our model predicts large macroeconomic losses from uninsurable business risk, much larger than those stemming from credit constraints. While self-financing allows entrepreneurs to quickly overcome credit constraints, even wealthy entrepreneurs remain considerably exposed to risk. (JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26)
abstract_zh: 我们利用企业层面数据证明，私营企业的利润份额存在大幅波动。这种波动源于产出的大规模、厚尾且暂时性的变化，而这些变化并未完全伴随投入要素的同步调整。我们通过一个企业家动态模型来解释这一现象。由于企业可以通过缩小经营规模来限制风险敞口，我们的模型预测，不可保的商业风险将导致巨大的宏观经济损失，其规模远超信贷约束所造成的损失。尽管自我融资使企业家能够迅速克服信贷约束，但即使是富裕的企业家仍面临显著的风险敞口。（JEL分类号：D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26）

title: The Complementary Role of Information and Contraceptive Access in Teen Pregnancy
title_zh: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用
authors: Kaytan, Sevin, Piedra-Bonilla, Stwarth, Zohar, Tom
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa Rican initiative that combined free access to long-acting reversible contraceptives and a tailored information campaign to correct for baseline misinformation. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access – an extra year of exposure to the information campaign is equivalent to the effect of contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the policy changed the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misinformation on sexual health.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了信息摩擦如何影响避孕措施提供项目的有效性。我们聚焦于哥斯达黎加的一项举措，该举措结合了长效可逆避孕药的免费获取与针对性的信息宣传，以纠正基线信息偏差。利用行政数据及该举措的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。研究表明，信息与获取渠道具有互补效应——额外一年的信息宣传接触所产生的效果，等同于仅提供避孕措施的效果。通过性行为调查数据，我们发现该政策将信息源从个人社交网络转向医疗专业人员，从而修正了关于性健康的信息偏差。

title: Insurer Risk and Public Risk-Sharing: Quantifying the Value of Reinsurance
title_zh: 保险公司风险与公共风险分担：再保险价值的量化
authors: Paul H S Kim, Anran Li
abstract: We study the role of public risk-sharing in markets where firms face substantial cost uncertainty, focusing on public reinsurance in health insurance. We develop a model where insurers internalize cost uncertainty through risk charges that raise effective marginal costs, and create a role for reinsurance. Public reinsurance lowers both expected costs and cost volatility, particularly for smaller insurers, reducing prices and enhancing competition. Using an event study of staggered state-level reinsurance programs, we show that public reinsurance leads insurers to lower prices and private reinsurance purchases, benefiting financially constrained insurers the most. Structural estimates indicate that risk charges account for a substantial share of the premium-cost wedge, and highlight public reinsurance's comparative advantage over premium subsidies by providing risk protection and enhancing competition. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for firms’ risk exposure in policy design and provide a general framework for understanding public risk-sharing policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究企业在面临巨大成本不确定性时公共风险分担的作用，重点关注健康保险中的公共再保险。我们构建了一个模型，其中保险公司通过风险费用将成本不确定性内部化，从而提高有效边际成本，并为再保险创造了空间。公共再保险降低了预期成本和成本波动性，尤其对小型保险公司而言，从而降低了价格并增强了竞争。利用各州分阶段实施再保险计划的事件研究法，我们发现公共再保险促使保险公司降低价格并减少私人再保险购买，对财务受限的保险公司影响最大。结构估计表明，风险费用在保费与成本差额中占很大比重，并凸显了公共再保险相较于保费补贴的比较优势，因为它能提供风险保护并增强竞争。我们的研究结果强调了在政策设计中考虑企业风险暴露的重要性，并为理解公共风险分担政策提供了一个通用框架。

title: Cleaner but Volatile Energy? The Effect of Coal Plant Retirement on Market Competition in the Wholesale Electricity Market
title_zh: 更清洁但更不稳定的能源？煤电厂退役对电力批发市场竞争的影响
abstract: The energy transition from coal to gas is reshaping the power sector to rely more on gas generation, which is cleaner but has more variable input costs. Using counterfactual analysis, I study the competitive effects of this transition, by considering several transition paths that differ in the types of firms involved in retiring coal plants and investing in gas plants. I show that the variable nature of the marginal cost of gas generation creates an environment in which market power could increase after the transition. However, the transition's impact on competition depends on the characteristics of the firms investing in new gas generation; the adverse impact is mitigated under a well‐planned transition that leads to a more competitive industry structure.
abstract_zh: 从煤炭向天然气的能源转型正重塑电力行业，使其更加依赖天然气发电——这种发电方式更清洁，但投入成本波动性更大。通过反事实分析，本文研究了这一转型的竞争效应，考虑了若干种不同的转型路径，这些路径在参与退役燃煤电厂和投资天然气电厂的企业类型上存在差异。研究表明，天然气发电边际成本的波动性特征创造了一种环境，使得转型后市场势力可能增强。然而，转型对竞争的影响取决于投资新建天然气发电企业的特征；在精心规划的转型路径下，这种不利影响会得到缓解，从而形成更具竞争性的行业结构。

title: Bounding the Effect of Persuasion with Monotonicity Assumptions: Reassessing the Impact of TV Debates
title_zh: 单调性假设下说服效应的边界：重新评估电视辩论的影响
abstract: Abstract Televised debates between presidential candidates are often regarded as the exemplar of persuasive communication. Yet, recent evidence from Le Pennec and Pons (2023) indicates that they may not sway voters as strongly as popular belief suggests. We revisit their findings through the lens of the persuasion rate and introduce a robust framework that does not require exogenous treatment, parallel trends, or credible instruments. Instead, we leverage plausible monotonicity assumptions to partially identify the persuasion rate and related parameters. Our results reaffirm that the sharp upper bounds on the persuasive effects of TV debates remain modest.
abstract_zh: 摘要 总统候选人之间的电视辩论常被视为说服性传播的典范。然而，Le Pennec与Pons（2023）的最新证据表明，其影响选民的程度可能远不及普遍认知。我们通过说服率视角重新审视其研究发现，并引入一个无需外生处理、平行趋势或可信工具变量的稳健框架。相反，我们利用合理的单调性假设对说服率及相关参数进行部分识别。研究结果再次证实，电视辩论说服效应的严格上界仍较为有限。

title: Long‐Term Debt and Short‐Term Rates: Fixed‐Rate Mortgages and Monetary Transmission
title_zh: 长期债务与短期利率：固定利率抵押贷款与货币政策传导
authors: ALESSIA DE STEFANI, RUI C. MANO
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: We study the two‐way relationship between fixed‐rate mortgages (FRMs) and monetary policy in a panel of up to 35 countries observed over the last two decades. The data set includes quarterly information on the composition of mortgage flows and stocks by type of rate‐fixation and monetary policy shocks cleaned of information effects. Using instrumental‐variable local projections, we show that FRMs induce both path‐ and state‐dependency in monetary transmission. Changes in policy rates shape mortgage choice, increasing (decreasing) the share of FRMs during easing (tightening) cycles. Over time, this mechanism alters the composition of the outstanding mortgage stock which, in turn, affects the central bank's ability to stabilize the economy ex‐post . A greater (lower) prevalence of FRMs weakens (strengthens) monetary policy transmission to real private consumption and GDP.
abstract_zh: 本文基于过去二十年间最多35个国家的面板数据，研究了固定利率抵押贷款（FRMs）与货币政策之间的双向关系。数据集包含按利率固定类型划分的抵押贷款流量与存量的季度信息，以及剔除信息效应后的货币政策冲击。通过工具变量局部投影法，我们证明FRMs在货币政策传导中同时引发路径依赖与状态依赖。政策利率的变化会塑造抵押贷款选择：在宽松（紧缩）周期中，FRMs占比上升（下降）。随着时间推移，这一机制改变了未偿还抵押贷款存量的构成，进而影响央行事后稳定经济的能力。FRMs的较高（较低）普及率会削弱（增强）货币政策向实际私人消费与GDP的传导效果。

title: Private Interest in the Public Good: Cholera and the Origins of Sanitary Reform
title_zh: 公共利益中的私人利益：霍乱与卫生改革的起源
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: European countries paved the way for modern economic growth in the 19th century with large-scale reforms facilitating human capital accumulation. The literature has looked at the role of elites in broad education investments, but less attention has been devoted to reforms promoting workers' health, a key component of human capital. This paper studies the impact of the 1866 cholera outbreak on modern waterworks construction in the German Empire to test the hypothesis whether concerns about workers' health may have compelled elites to invest in health-enhancing public goods. We find that the epidemic raised the annual probability of building waterworks by about 35%. Exogenous variation relying on the cholera-spreading effect of military movements during the Austro-Prussian War in 1866 further underpins this result. Quantitative and qualitative evidence indicates that non-agricultural elites employing more productive capital and better-skilled workers pushed for reform to avoid the costly prospect of future labour shocks. Long-term analyses show sizeable and persisting effects of the epidemic on public health and development outcomes shortly before the First World War.

title: An almost laboratory experiment: John Cowperthwaite and Hong Kong’s economic prosperity
title_zh: 近乎实验室实验：约翰·考珀斯韦特与香港经济繁荣
authors: Vincent Geloso, Jamie Bologna Pavlik, Yang Zhou
abstract: Milton Friedman, in the 1960s, was convinced that John Cowperthwaite, the British official overseeing Hong Kong’s economic policy, was conducting the most radical experiment in economic history. A staunch classical liberal within the British civil service, Cowperthwaite aggressively resisted government intervention, believing that free markets fueled growth. His influence was amplified by British domestic politics and the nature of colonial rule, making him a uniquely powerful figure. In this paper, we use the Synthetic Control Method (SCM) and Synthetic Difference-in-Differences (SDID) to assess whether Cowperthwaite truly constrained government expansion and whether his policies drove economic growth. In other words, we test whether Friedman overstated Cowperthwaite’s impact. We find strong evidence that Cowperthwaite limited government growth but had no visible effect on economic growth. We link these results to Hong Kong’s land policies, their impact on government size metrics, and more even-handed assessments of Cowperthwaite’s policy decisions.
abstract_zh: 20世纪60年代，米尔顿·弗里德曼确信，负责香港经济政策的英国官员约翰·考珀斯韦特正在实施经济史上最激进的实验。作为英国文官体系中坚定的古典自由主义者，考珀斯韦特强烈抵制政府干预，坚信自由市场能推动增长。英国国内政治与殖民统治的特性放大了他的影响力，使其成为一位拥有独特权力的关键人物。本文采用合成控制法（SCM）与合成双重差分法（SDID），评估考珀斯韦特是否真正限制了政府扩张，以及他的政策是否推动了经济增长。换言之，我们检验弗里德曼是否夸大了考珀斯韦特的影响。研究发现，考珀斯韦特确实限制了政府规模增长，但对经济增长并无显著影响。我们将这些结果与香港的土地政策、其对政府规模指标的影响，以及对考珀斯韦特政策决策更为公允的评价联系起来。
